data.businessDescription: Cloetta AB manufacturse, and markets sugar confectionery, chocolate products, pastilles, and chewing gum. It operates through the following geographical segments: Scandinavia, Sweden, Finland, Norway and Denmark, Middle, International Markets and the UK, and The Netherlands and Germany. The company was founded by Bernhard Cloetta, Christoffer Cloetta and Nutin Cloetta in 1862 and is headquartered in Sundbyberg, Sweden.

Peab AB engages in the provision of construction and civil engineering services. It operates through the following segments: Construction, Civil Engineering, Industry, and Project Development. The Construction segment offers construction related services and housing production. The Civil Engineering segment constructs large infrastructures and civil engineering projects and smaller projects on the local market. The Industry segment includes the following product areas: asphalt, concrete, gravel and rock, transportation and machines, rentals, and construction systems. The Project Development segment develops housings and properties. The company was founded by Erik Gustav Paulsson and Mats O. Paulsson in 1959 and is headquartered in Forslov, Sweden.

Baltic Classifieds Group Plc engages in the business of online classifieds portal for automotive, real estate, jobs and services, and general merchandise. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

Oil & Natural Gas Corp. Ltd. engages in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil, natural gas, and value added products. The firm operates through the following business segments: Exploration & Production and Refining & Marketing. The company was founded on August 14, 1956 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

IRB Infrastructure Developers Ltd. engages in the construction and maintenance of roads and highways. It operates through the Built, Operate and Transfer (BOT) and Toll, Operate and Transfer (TOT) Projects, InvITs and Related Assets, and Construction segments. The BOT and TOT Projects segment focuses on the operation and maintenance of roadways. The InvITs and Related Assets segment consists of investments in units of IRB Infrastructure Trust, IRB InvIT Fund and other related assets. The Construction segment is involved in the development of roads. The company was founded on July 27, 1998 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Vedanta Ltd. is a natural resource company, which engages in the exploration, extraction, and processing of minerals, oil, and gas properties. It operates through the following segments: Copper, Aluminum, Iron Ore, Power, and Oil & Gas. The Copper segment focuses in custom smelting and also include a copper smelter, a refinery, a phosphoric acid plant, a sulphuric acid plant, a copper rod plant, and three captive power plants. The Aluminum segment comprises refinery and a captive power plant at Lanjigarh and a smelter, a thermal coal based captive power facility at Jharsuguda both situated in the State of Odisha in India. The Iron Ore segment explores, mines, and processes iron ore, pig iron, and metallurgical coke. The Power segment consists 600 MW thermal coal-based commercial power facility at Jharsuguda in the State of Odisha in Eastern India. The Oil and Gas segment involves in the exploration and development and production of oil and gas. The company was founded by Dwarka Prasad Agarwal on June 25, 1965 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Mangalore Refinery & Petrochemicals Ltd. is an oil refining company, which engages in the petroleum refinery services. It offers diesel, motor spirit, and aviation turbines fuels. The company was founded on March 7, 1988 and is headquartered in Mangalore, India.

UPL Ltd. engages in the business of manufacturing and sale of pesticides, insecticide, and micronutrients. It operates through the following segments: Crop Protection, Seeds Business, and Non-Agro. The Crop Protection segment includes the manufacture and marketing of conventional agrochemical products, and other agricultural related products. The Seeds Business segment manufactures seeds. The Non-Agro segment focuses on the manufacturing and marketing of industrial chemical and other non-agricultural related products. The company was founded by Rajnikant Devidas Shroff on May 29, 1969 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Vodafone Idea Ltd. engages in the provision of telecommunication services. It provides pan-India voice and data services across 2G, 3G, and 4G platforms. The company was founded on March 14, 1995 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Oil India Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the business of exploration, development and production of crude oil and natural gas, transportation of crude oil and production of LPG. It operates through the following segments: Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Liquefied Petroleum Gas, Pipeline Transportation, Renewable Energy, and Others. The company was founded on February 18, 1959 and is headquartered in Noida, India.

data.businessDescription: Tata Chemicals Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture and sale of inorganic chemicals. It operates through the Basic Chemistry Products and Specialty Products. The Basic Chemistry Products segment offers soda ash and other bulk chemicals. The Specialty Products segment consists of nutrition solutions and advance materials. The company was founded on January 23, 1939 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

NMDC Steel Ltd. engages in production of iron ore. It also focuses on production of hot rolled coils, liquid steel, hot metal, pig iron, gross sinter, and gross coke. The company was founded on January 2, 2015 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

Afcons Infrastructure Ltd. engages in the provision of civil construction and engineering services. The firm focuses on marine and industrial, surface transport, urban infrastructure, oil and gas, hydro and underground water business units. It operates through the India and Other Countries geographical segments. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

National Aluminium Co. Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of metallurgical grade alumina. It operates through the following segments: Chemical and Aluminium. The Chemical segment includes Calcined Alumina, Alumina Hydrate, and related products. The Aluminium segment covers the aluminium ingots, wire rods, billets, strips, rolled, and related products. The company was founded on January 7, 1981 and is headquartered in Bhubaneswar, India.

KEC International Ltd. engages in the provision of infrastructure engineering, procurement, and construction services. The firm operates through the following segments: Engineering, Procurement and Construction business (EPC) and Others. The EPC segment comprises of infrastructure related projects, systems, products and related activities for power transmission and distribution, railways track laying, electrification, civil, urban infrastructure, and oil and gas pipelines laying. The Others segment includes cable business. It operates through the following geographical segments: India, UAE, Brazil, Mexico, and USA. The company was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

InterGlobe Aviation Ltd. engages in the provision of air transportation services. Its activities include the transportation of passengers, cargo, and mail on regularly scheduled flights and the provision of car rental, airport lounge, visa information, and insurance services. The company was founded by Rahul Bhatia and Rakesh Gangwal on January 13, 2004 and is headquartered in Gurgaon, India.

Tata Steel Ltd. is a holding company,which engages in the manufacture and distribution of steel and steel products. Its products include Tata Tiscon, Tata Steelium, Tata Shaktee, Tata Astrum, Tata Pipes, Tata Wiron, Tata Agrico, Precision Tubes, and Bearings. The company was founded on August 26, 1907 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

BLS International Services Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of visa and other allied services. The firm includes outsourced visa processing, verification of documents, attestation of documents, passport services, e-visa services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Middle East, Asia Pacific, North America, Europe, South Africa, and India. The company was founded on November 7, 1983 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

Chennai Petroleum Corp. Ltd. engages in the manufacturing, marketing, distributing, and supplying of petroleum and other related products. It offers products such as liquefied petroleum gas, motor spirit, superior kerosene, aviation turbine fuel, high speed diesel, naphtha, bitumen, lube base stocks, paraffin wax, fuel oil, hexane, and petrochemical feed stocks. The company was founded on December 30, 1965 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.

Knowledge Realty Trust is an Indian real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on owning, developing, and managing a large portfolio of Grade A commercial office properties. The company was founded on October 10, 2024 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
